w10_T4_003532: A stamp club had 24 albums at the start of the year, bought 31 more and was given 75 by a retiring member. Every album holds exactly 3 sheets of stamps. The club meets in a room that seats 40 people. All of the sheets were then shared equally among the 6 branches of the club, and the Riverside branch took one of those shares. The club records its meeting lengths in minutes although the annual report gives them in hours. How many sheets did the Riverside branch receive?
w10_T4_003533: On Monday morning a warehouse held 210 sacks of rice, and a delivery added 10 more. At midday the stock was split evenly, and the manager kept half of the sacks at the main site while the rest went to a second store. During the afternoon 48 sacks were sold from the main site. Later that afternoon a returned order brought 63 sacks back to it. In the evening 68 sacks were driven from the main site to a food bank. How many sacks were left at the main site?
w10_T4_003540: Amara had 168 packets of glass beads and tripled that stock at a craft fair. Her cousin Felix then gave her 48 more packets, although Felix owns fewer packets than Amara does. The fair itself lasted 4 days. Every packet holds 9 beads. Each bead is cut with 9 flat facets. How many facets were there on all of Amara's beads?
w10_T4_003542: On Monday morning a swimming pool had 205 lockers standing free. Before lunch 34 more lockers were freed as swimmers left. During the afternoon session 98 lockers were taken, and in the early evening another 58 were claimed. Just before closing a late group took 5 more. The pool advertises its sessions in minutes even though the membership card lists them in hours. How many lockers were still free?
w10_T4_003553: A community choir had 23 rehearsal slots booked for the term and handed 11 of them back to the hall. Every slot that remained needs 5 minutes of setting up, and the choir added those minutes together. A dress rehearsal added 66 more minutes of setting up to the total. The choir keeps this record in minutes, although the hall's booking form is filled in with hours. The whole setup job was then shared equally among the 3 volunteers, and Mei took one of those equal shares. How many minutes of setting up did Mei take on?
w10_T4_003554: A bakery began with 40 kilograms of flour and divided it equally between its 2 ovens, setting the first oven's share aside. A supplier added 18 kilograms to that share. Every kilogram in it makes 5 rolls, and the bakery counted the rolls. A cancelled order returned 41 rolls, and a second bakery sent over 43. The rolls were then split equally between 2 shops, and the shop on Mill Street took one of those parts. The bakery records its proving times in minutes even though the recipe cards give them in hours. How many rolls went to the Mill Street shop?
w10_T4_003559: A tile factory produces 128 tiles on each of its 6 lines. The tiles are split equally between 2 warehouses, and the north warehouse takes one of those parts. Each tile in the north warehouse is packed with 6 spacers, and the spacers are counted. Every spacer is moulded in 2 halves, and every half is stamped with 8 markings. The factory car park holds 90 cars. The supervisor Cara counted more markings than her colleague Ben did on his own shift, and Ben found 34 extra markings on a set of loose halves that were added to the count. How many markings were counted in all?
w10_T4_003563: A village hall had 203 folding chairs in its store. A closing club donated 77 chairs, and a school lent it 79 more. A dozen of the chairs are the padded ones kept for concerts. A wedding party took 115 chairs away for the weekend. A neighbouring hall then sent over 56 chairs. How many chairs were in the store?
w10_T4_003566: A cinema had 201 rolls of ticket paper in its store and bought 58 more. A venue that closed sent over 23 rolls. A busy season used up 59 rolls, and a supplier then delivered 35. The chain tripled that whole stock when it took over a second cinema with an identical store. The chain measures its film lengths in minutes although the listings are printed in hours. A last delivery added 9 rolls. How many rolls of ticket paper did the chain hold?
w10_T4_003570: A hotel had 219 sets of bed linen in its laundry store, a dozen of them oversized for the family rooms. 178 sets went out to the guest rooms, and 5 sets were thrown away as torn. The linen still in the store was shared equally among the 6 floors of the hotel, and the top floor took one of those shares. 1 set on the top floor was ruined by a spill. Housekeeping then carried 48 fresh sets up to that floor. The hotel records its cleaning times in minutes even though the staff rota is drawn up in hours. How many sets of linen did the top floor have?
w10_T4_003573: On Monday morning a print shop had 102 reams of paper and bought 55 more. During the afternoon a delivery added 66 reams. That evening the shop tripled its holding by taking over the stock of a firm that had closed. The reams were then divided equally between the 3 branches, and the manager Petra took the share for her own branch, which left her with fewer reams than her colleague Anders had at head office. Petra's branch used 209 reams on a large job. How many reams did Petra's branch have left?
w10_T4_003575: On Saturday morning a bike shop that has traded for 25 years had 98 spare tyres in its stockroom. 8 tyres were fitted before lunch. In the early afternoon a delivery brought 60 more tyres. Later that afternoon the tyres were shared equally among the 3 branches, and the High Street branch took one of the shares. In the evening 12 tyres were sold from that branch. The shop records repair times in minutes although the price list quotes hours. How many tyres did the High Street branch have left?
w10_T4_003577: On Monday morning a school kitchen had 18 crates of fruit and doubled that number with an emergency order. Later that morning a farm donated 47 crates. During the afternoon 29 crates were sent to a sister school, which left that school's cook Baptiste with fewer crates than the head cook Marie still had. In the evening Marie had every crate she kept repacked into 3 boxes. Each of those boxes was then filled with 9 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit did Marie's kitchen hold?
w10_T4_003578: A depot took in 168 bundles of newspapers and pulped 37 of them as unsold. Each remaining bundle holds 8 newspapers. Every newspaper carries 5 advertising inserts. The identical delivery is made to 7 towns. The manager Ivo counted more inserts than his colleague Dana did on her own round. The depot logs its delivery times in minutes even though the contract with the printers is written in hours. How many inserts were delivered in total?
w10_T4_003585: A sign-making workshop had 89 sheets of acrylic and bought 34 more, a dozen of which were tinted. Each sheet is cut into 6 blanks. Every blank is drilled with 8 fixing holes, and the workshop counted those holes. A test panel added 13 more holes, but a batch of 1383 holes had to be discounted because those blanks had warped. A late job added 49 holes to the count. The workshop times its cutting in minutes even though the quotes to customers are given in hours. How many holes were counted at the end?
w10_T4_003586: A car park attendant issued 222 tickets at each of the 4 gates one morning. By the end of the day 762 of those tickets had been handed back at the exit. A coach party then took 58 tickets, and a late event accounted for 79 more. The attendant Yara kept a bigger tally than her colleague Emeka did at the side gate. The car park records stay lengths in minutes although its charges are advertised by the hour. How many tickets were still in circulation?
w10_T4_003590: A gym had 69 lockers in the main changing room and installed 31 more. Every locker is issued with 6 wristbands over a season, and the gym counted those wristbands. A supplier sent 29 spare wristbands. Members lost 49 wristbands during the season. The gym records class lengths in minutes even though the timetable on the wall is set out in hours. How many wristbands did the gym have?
w10_T4_003591: On Monday morning a farm shop had 20 trays of eggs and collected 27 more from the hen houses. Before lunch 33 trays were sold to a hotel. In the afternoon every tray still in the shop was emptied and the eggs were boxed 6 to a box. In the evening the shop learned that an identical delivery had to be prepared for each of 7 markets. How many boxes of eggs did the shop prepare in all?
w10_T4_003602: A theatre company had 86 costumes in store and hired 53 more. A touring production then took 132 costumes away. The wardrobe department bought 75 costumes at an auction and inherited 76 from a company that closed. The rehearsal room is 18 metres long. A fire inspection condemned 108 costumes. Every costume that survived was hung with 6 accessories. How many accessories were hung?
w10_T4_003603: On Monday morning a school had 110 tablets in its charging trolley, which weighs 40 kilograms, and 66 tablets were signed out for a trip. Each tablet still in the trolley was loaded with 3 exam papers, and the school counted those papers. During the afternoon 119 papers were found to be out of date and were deleted. In the evening the technician Bram printed every remaining paper as 8 separate copies. His colleague Suki printed fewer copies that evening than Bram did. A late order added 35 copies, and a reprint added 46 more. How many copies did the school have?
w10_T4_003608: A cannery packs 86 tins into every carton. Each pallet holds 5 cartons, and each lorry carries 4 pallets. The cannery sent out 2 identical lorries on the same run. The loading bay is 12 metres wide. Shops sold 2498 of the tins from that run. The cannery records its cooking times in minutes even though the labels state hours. How many tins from the run were left unsold?
w10_T4_003609: A phone repair shop had 200 replacement screens in stock and ordered 80 more. A bulk repair job used 260 screens, and 3 more cracked while being fitted. A supplier then delivered 21 screens. Warranty work consumed 22 screens, and a training session used up 13. The shop quotes its repair times in minutes although the customer leaflet talks about hours. How many replacement screens were left in stock?
w10_T4_003610: Priya bakes 77 biscuits on each of her 2 baking trays. She fills both trays and runs the oven 2 times in a morning. Every biscuit is decorated with 3 sugar flowers, and Priya counted the flowers she would need. Her neighbour Callum decorated fewer biscuits than Priya did. The oven takes 14 minutes to heat up. A friend then gave Priya 57 spare sugar flowers. How many sugar flowers did Priya have?
w10_T4_003616: A hostel had 127 mattresses and sent 42 of them for recycling. A hostel that closed donated 59 mattresses, a dozen of them the extra-long kind. Every mattress is turned 7 times a year, and the hostel counted those turns. Each turn is logged with 9 separate checks. The hostel writes its cleaning times in minutes even though the staff contract counts them in hours. How many checks are logged in a year?
w10_T4_003618: A recycling centre had 236 crates of bottles at the start of the week. A supermarket delivered 63 crates, a school added 25, and a cafe brought in 17. The crates are stacked in the yard behind the sorting shed. Every crate holds 6 bottles, and the centre counted its bottles before the lorry came. How many bottles did the centre count?
